Class ManagerController

java.lang.Object
ManagerController
public class ManagerController extends Object
Controller for the dashboard, menu items, inventory, employees, sales, and orders.

    • refreshSalesReport

    • generateSalesByItemReport

      private void generateSalesByItemReport()
      Generates the Sales by Item report for the dates in the From and To pickers (both inclusive). Lists every menu item, sorted by revenue, with its orders, quantity sold, revenue, share of total revenue, and average price per drink, plus a summary line of the window's totals. Shows a message instead if a date is missing or the To date is before the From date.

      Runs when the manager clicks Generate Report, and automatically when the Daily, Weekly, or Monthly period changes.

    • loadSalesChart

      private void loadSalesChart(String period, String startDate, String endDate)
      Loads sales data into the revenue chart. Groups sales by time intervals based on the selected period.
      Parameters:
      period - the selected period (today, week, or month)
      startDate - the start date of the sales period
      endDate - the end date of the sales period

      private void loadProductUsageChart(String startDate, String endDate)
      Loads inventory usage for the selected sales period. Calculates the amount of each ingredient used based on the quantity of drinks sold and their recipes.
      Parameters:

      endDate - the ending date of the sales period

    • openSeasonalItem

      private void openSeasonalItem()
      Opens the New Seasonal Item form (seasonal.fxml) in its own window on top of the manager screen. When the window closes, the manager tables are reloaded so the new drink and any new inventory items appear right away. Shows an error on the Menu page if the form cannot be opened.

    • loadRestockMinimums

      private void loadRestockMinimums()
      Loads the saved minimum inventory quantities from the database. These values are used to determine which items need restocking.

    • saveInventoryMinimum

      private void saveInventoryMinimum()
      Saves the minimum stock quantity selected by the manager. Updates the inventory database so the value is saved and can be used when generating the restock report.

    • generateRestockReport

      private void generateRestockReport()
      Generates a restock report by comparing current inventory quantities with their saved minimum quantities. Only items below their minimum are included in the report.

    • exportRestockCSV

      private void exportRestockCSV()
      Exports the restock report to a CSV file. Allows the manager to save the report for later use.

    • exportRestockTXT

      private void exportRestockTXT()
      Exports the restock report to a text file. Allows the manager to save a readable copy of the report.
